body.text:
If anyone finds this — the sculpture is OUT. Chamber window failed at the 03:47 surge. We did the rotation right, we did everything right, but the lights went and Okafor blinked, we all blinked—

It doesn't wander. It HUNTS. It knows where the dark is. The residue trails are its territory marks, follow them BACKWARD, never forward.

I'm making for stairwell S-3 with Reyes. If the door's still sealed we'll try the supervisor's office for a blue card.

Don't run. Running is a sound. Walk, watch, and blink one eye at a time — it doesn't fall for it but you'll feel braver.

— A.V.
